state: The draft currently saves outbox receipts independently from domain records. These contain operation-derived IDs, pending or terminal/uncertain transport state, typed outcome and redacted failure, with immutable message text and provider idempotency. Minimum ordinary retention is seven days; private payloads cannot be kept or disclosed merely to satisfy a reference. Authored applications separately retain delivery text IDs and copy completion status. In Grant the reviewer operation first authorizes its assignee/location/state and budget, then records a decision and mail attempt; the callback has no domain work beyond matching the ID and copying status. Propose freezes a valid priced offer under salesperson authority; mail completion renames succeeded to delivered. Its document callback validates source/revision before attaching a file. Mail staff record physical receipt under location and service guards, send conditionally, and later advance received to notified on matching success; reminders can install a newer ID. These latter reactions must remain authored and cannot accept an older attempt. The language has no deployed implementation to preserve, and already has action(target) opaque references. We seek a small explicit associated-delivery contract supporting both interfaces, safe historic outcomes, no raw directory of receipts and no automatic business confirmation. Selection must account for costs as well as source repetition; no measured savings are available.

association.instructions: Pick the smallest coherent authoring contract for the stated cases, including operational drawbacks.

criteria.typed_reference: Store a nullable typed delivery(operation) handle returned by send in the owning record. Its immutable identity exposes current protected receipt observations without copying them into business columns. Retained links keep safe summary but do not revive expired result content. Receipt changes do not advance the business version; explicit completion code compares current handle.id and performs all actual state/file effects. This requires specifying a reference kind and observation consistency.
criteria.associated_effect: Provide an into-record-field form of send and compiler-generated transport metadata, along with a per-field completion form. The app names one association and writes only genuine reactions. This reduces handwritten matching and update code further, but introduces additional effect/hook notation plus implicit field/version/lock behavior and still must solve lifetime/access.
criteria.explicit_mirrors: Keep the existing explicit delivery ID column, pending update and completion-to-status assignment, with the standard renderer handling labels uniformly. Source remains longer and error-prone correlation/mirrors stay repeated, but ordinary domain updates retain familiar versions/locks and no association primitive is introduced.
